title: KunAgent/Kun

zh.gap: 串起来不是稀缺的那一环；稀缺的是第一环——把一个模糊的「我想要」问成一份规格的那场澄清访谈。这条赛道上所有工具都默认你带着写好的规格来。
zh.pain: 有清楚想法、没有团队的人——现在得找四种不同的人帮忙，才能从「我想要这个」走到「能拿出手的东西」。
zh.kill: 多段式 agent 工作区是 2026 年最拥挤的品类，绝大多数死在第二次交接：前面一个小误解，四步之后放大成一个没法用的产物。
zh.move: 只留第一环，单独卖：一场澄清访谈，结束时给出一页规格——普通人可以拿它去找真人外包，也可以喂给任何 agent。冷启动：中文＝小红书/即刻「找人做个小程序被坑」的帖子；英文＝r/freelance 与 r/Upwork 里客户拿不出 brief 的讨论。

pick_reason: KunAgent/Kun addresses a clear need for integrated AI tools in software development, though competition in the space is significant.
gap: Chaining is not the scarce part; the scarce part is the first link — the clarifying interview that turns a vague want into a spec. Every tool in this space assumes you arrive with the spec already written.
pain: The person with a clear idea and no team — who currently has to hire four different kinds of help to get from 'I want this' to something they can show.
kill: Multi-stage agent workspaces are the most crowded category of 2026 and most die at the second handoff, where a small early misunderstanding compounds into an unusable artifact four steps later.
move: Keep only the first link and sell it alone: a clarifying interview that ends with a one-page spec a normal person can hand to a human freelancer OR to any agent. Cold start CN = 小红书/即刻「找人做个小程序被坑」帖; EN = r/freelance and r/Upwork threads where clients arrive with no brief.
